a: $6,000 for a 12–24 week project; $12,000 for 24–48 weeks or two projects
dt: Rolling; apply at least 16 weeks before planned start
e: For senior undergraduates, graduate students and postdocs (within 5 years of PhD) on research exchanges into or out of Canada. Most countries are eligible, including the US. Funds research visits between US and Canadian NANOGrav/CHIME groups.
unv: Institution-level allocations and internal deadlines vary (e.g. UBC)
